en-US.name: CHAINBRIEF
en-US.subtitle: Crypto news, briefed fast
en-US.description:
CHAINBRIEF is a fast, clean crypto news reader. Breaking headlines, short analysis and exchange listing updates in one calm feed.

• Live flash news: the market-moving headlines of the day, marked when they matter
• Analysis: short, sourced articles that explain what happened and why it matters
• Exchange listings: new spot and futures listings, warnings and delistings across major global exchanges, plus upcoming listings
• Markets: prices and daily moves for the coins people follow
• Save to read later, even offline
• English, 中文 and 한국어 editions
• Light and dark themes

CHAINBRIEF is a news and information app. It does not offer trading, wallets or investment advice, and nothing in the app is a recommendation to buy or sell any asset.
en-US.promo: Breaking crypto headlines, short analysis and exchange listings in one calm feed. English and 中文 editions.

zh-Hans.name: CHAINBRIEF
zh-Hans.subtitle: 加密快讯，一眼读懂
zh-Hans.description:
CHAINBRIEF 是一款简洁、快速的加密货币新闻阅读器。突发快讯、简短分析与交易所上币动态，集中在一个清爽的信息流里。

• 实时快讯：当天影响市场的重要消息，重点新闻醒目标记
• 深度分析：有出处的短篇文章，讲清发生了什么、为何重要
• 交易所上币：主要交易所的现货与合约新上币、风险提示与下架信息，以及即将上线的项目
• 行情：常见币种的价格与日涨跌
• 收藏文章，离线也能阅读
• English、中文、한국어 三个版本
• 浅色与深色主题

CHAINBRIEF 仅提供新闻与资讯，不提供交易、钱包或投资建议，应用内任何内容均不构成买卖任何资产的推荐。
zh-Hans.keywords: 加密货币,比特币,区块链,快讯,新闻,以太坊,上币,行情,稳定币,ETF,Web3,DeFi
zh-Hans.promo: 加密货币突发快讯、简短分析与交易所上币动态，一个清爽的信息流全部看完。

review.notes:
1. SCREEN RECORDING (physical iPhone, latest iOS): https://probe2928-crypto.github.io/chainbrief/review/chainbrief-ios-1.3.0.mp4
(Recorded on iPhone with the TestFlight build 1.3.0 (16): launch from TestFlight → Live/Flash → article reader → share → bookmark → Prices → Saved → Settings, language KO→EN.)

2. PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
CHAINBRIEF is a free crypto news reader: flash news, in-depth articles, new exchange listing announcements and market prices in one native app, in English, Chinese and Korean.
Audience: adults who follow the crypto market and want fast, multilingual, ad-light news.
Problem it solves: listing notices and market news are scattered across many exchanges and sites in different languages; CHAINBRIEF gathers, summarizes and translates them in one place.

3. HOW TO USE (no login, no account, no purchases)
- Launch the app: the Flash tab shows the latest news. Pull down to refresh.
- Articles tab: tap any article to open the reader; use the bookmark icon to save it and the share icon to share it.
- Listings tab: new token listings announced by major exchanges. Prices tab: live prices of major coins.
- Saved tab: saved articles (available offline) and Settings, where you can switch language (EN / 中文 / 한국어) and light/dark theme.

4. EXTERNAL SERVICES
- Our own news site on GitHub Pages (probe2928-crypto.github.io/chainbrief): all news and article content is delivered as JSON feeds.
- Market data (public, read-only APIs): CoinGecko, Upbit, Bithumb; Fear & Greed index from alternative.me.
- Listing announcements are collected on our server from exchanges' public notice pages (Upbit, Bithumb, Binance, OKX, Bybit, Coinbase).
- Translation of news is assisted by Anthropic's Claude API on our server before publishing; the app itself makes no AI calls.
- Telegram channel link (opens in the in-app browser).
- Small partner banners for non-exchange crypto information services are set in our own config and open in the in-app browser (no ad network).
- No login/authentication service, no payment processor, no analytics or ad SDKs in the app.

5. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app works the same in every region where it is offered. It is not offered in mainland China. Content is available in English, Chinese and Korean.

6. REGULATED ACTIVITY / THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL
CHAINBRIEF provides news and information only. It does not offer trading, exchange sign-up or referral links, wallets, custody, mining, ICOs or investment advice, so no financial license applies. News text is our own writing or summaries with links to the original public sources; prices come from public APIs.
